summary: Polls two monitored state sources and dispatches a notification when either cached value changes. First source is fetched through a virtual accessor on the this+0x40 sub-object (slot +0x1C, argument 3); its value is extracted via GuardedAccessor (0x0048D360) and compared against the cached value at this+0x11C. Second source is fetched through the global dispatch interface dword_7CD8C0 (slot +0x1C, command 18) and compared against the cached value at this+0x120. When a cache differs, it is updated and a virtual notification callback (vtable slot +0xA0) is invoked on this. Always returns 0.

operations.description: Fetch first monitored state object through virtual accessor at slot +0x1C of the this+0x40 sub-object, passing argument 3.
Guard: proceed only if the fetched state object is non-null and the cached value this+0x11C differs from GuardedAccessor(state).
Call GuardedAccessor on the first state object to extract its integer value.
Update cached first state value this+0x11C to the extracted value.
Invoke virtual notification callback at vtable slot +0xA0 on this to signal the first state changed.
Fetch second monitored state object through virtual accessor at slot +0x1C of the dword_7CD8C0 dispatch interface, passing command 18.
Guard: proceed only if the second state object is non-null and the cached value this+0x120 differs from the value read at offset 372 of that object.
Update cached second state value this+0x120 to the value read at offset 372 of the second state object.
Invoke virtual notification callback at vtable slot +0xA0 on this to signal the second state changed.
